Title: Azure Backup available in Australia Central regions

Body.Content:
Azure Backup has expanded its operations to Australia Central and Australia Central 2.

Azure Backup can back up (or protect) and restore your data in the Microsoft cloud. Azure Backup enables Azure IaaS VM backup and can replace your existing on-premises or off-site backup solution with a cloud-based solution that is reliable, secure, and cost-competitive. Customers in the Australia Central regions can now use Azure Backup with the same reliability and performance levels described in the Backup SLA.

For more information, see the Azure Backup technical documentation.
